comments.author: Cassard
comments.body:
Principe island
Do you have any idea what "Principe" is all about? Well the job is to find out more about it. The client probably doesn't know much about it, either. I think Admiral Dias may know something though... why don't you go have a chat with him?

1. Admiral Dias, Lisbon
Principe? Head southeast from the town of Saint-Georges. You'll find Sao Tome there. I visited there myself when I went around the Cape of Good Hope. You should ask about recent events at Principe when you go there.

2. Port Official, Sao Tome
Yes. The island of Principe is northeast of Sao Tome. It isn't far - you should reach it quickly. ... You didn't think that was the name of a person, did you?

3. Principe (Recognition at sea 255, 4724)
Principe is the name of an island in the Gulf of Guinea and is located to the north-east of Sao Tome.
I should get close to the coast and use the "Recognition" command to investigate all the details of the area.
